Their head coach was [[Rick Barnes]], who was in his 13th year. The team played its home games at the [[Frank Erwin Center]] in [[Austin, TX|Austin]], [[Texas]] and are members of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. They finished the season 28–8, 13–3 in Big 12 play and lost in the championship game of the [[2011 Big 12 men's basketball tournament]] to [[2010–11 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]]. They received an at-large bid in the [[2011 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]] where they defeated [[2010–11 Oakland Golden Grizzlies men's basketball team|Oakland]] in the second round
